title: Regeneration
definition: Regeneration is the Holy Spirit’s work of giving new spiritual life to those who were dead in sin.
summary: Regeneration is the Holy Spirit’s work of giving new spiritual life to those who were dead in sin.
christFocus: Jesus gives new birth by the Spirit, making sinners alive to God and bringing them into the life of His kingdom.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Regeneration means salvation is not merely behavior change or religious improvement. Scripture describes sinners as spiritually dead and needing new life that only God can give.

The Holy Spirit gives a new heart, awakens faith, and begins a new life of repentance and obedience. Regeneration does not make people instantly mature, but it does make them alive to God in a way they were not before.

Jesus told Nicodemus that one must be born again. This new birth comes from above, through the Spirit, and brings people into the kingdom of God through Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People often try to repair themselves with willpower, shame, or external change. Regeneration gives deeper hope: God does not merely patch up the old life; He gives new life in Christ.

This is vital for recovery and discipleship because lasting change begins with God’s life-giving work, not self-rescue.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask God to make your life show the reality of new birth. Depend on the Holy Spirit to produce new desires, new obedience, and new fruit, and do not reduce Christianity to behavior management apart from Christ.
